notes.title: Minor Update Patch Notes 2024.12.17
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Thank you for checking out 'The Devil Within: Satgat!' This next patch fixes a few things, but also adjusts some parts of the game that were major pain points for the community. 

The following has been updated in the latest version of the game on December 17th GMT+9.

[Changes and Fixes]
- Changed the fast-travel map to be the same as the full map. 

- Adjusted Stage 4's [spoiler]Purgatory section[/spoiler] so that if a demon touches you, you no longer go back to the save point instantly. 
ㄴ After this change, you will take damage rather than being sent back to the save point right away. 

- Improved the Nameless sword's 'Shock Accumulation Rate' by 15%.

- Made various changes with [spoiler]The Exalted One's[/spoiler] boss fight
ㄴ There was a lot of feedback that the due to various reasons, this particular boss fights devalues the counterattack experience, even though it is a focal point.
ㄴ Therefore, the following changes have been made:
* Adjusted the duration of the boss' fist remains after the punch attacks (staying longer so that you can land more hits through your attacks).
* The hit-box for the boss has been increased, allowing the player more opportunities to attack.
* Adjusted the phase 2 transition to happen slightly earlier than before.
* Increased the health of the boss slightly.
* Slightly decreased the time it takes for the boss to summon the planets, but significantly increased the time it takes for the boss to summon the final planet. (you do not want the boss to summon the final planet)

- Fixed an issue where shooting the [spoiler]Thunder gun[/spoiler] would not behave as intended under certain circumstances. 
- Fixed an issue where pressing certain buttons at a save point would make a strange sound. 
- Fixed an issue where the player would face the wrong direction after being hit with a projectile from the toxic bat enemies. 
- Fixed an issue where a specific sub-boss in the Restricted Zone 21 would stop under certain circumstances. 
- Fixed an issue where the boss of the expanded area of Restricted Zone 21 phase transitions would not work as intended. 
- Fixed an issue where the chest icons on the map would appear closed after interacting with Silver/Gold Chests and then dying. 
- Fixed an issue where the firearm HUD would not work as intended when firing a firearm while on a conveyor belt.
- Fixed an issue where under certain circumstances, multiple things can be selected while using the Haetae Statue, preventing the usage of the statue.
- Fixed an issue where under certain circumstances, accessory effects would not work as intended after the player has died and respawned. 

We hope you continue to enjoy 'The Devil Within: Satgat.'

notes.title: Minor Update Patch Notes 2024.11.28
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
It's has been a week since we released The Devil Within: Satgat. Despite some of the issues that have affected the player experience, we are so thrilled to see all of you enjoying our game. The passion with which you play our game is such a boost for us. 

Over the past week, our development team has been working tirelessly on resolving the issues that you, our passionate community, have been reporting. This patch will fix a lot of the known issues and will also improve the player experience. If you encounter any further issues, please feel free to let us know through the official Discord, through Steam, or through other means. We promise to respond as quickly as possible. 

This patch contains not just bug fixes, but also changes that will have a large impact on gameplay. The following has been updated in the latest version of the game on November 28th GMT+9.

1. Jump Improvements
A lot of you have asked for jump mechanic improvements. Because changing the jump mechanics would change the overall level design of each stage, we had to be careful balancing player feedback with preserving certain parts of the originally intended player experience. In this update, we've slightly raised the jump height and changed it to feel a bit more smooth. With this change, certain parts of specific levels will feel a lot better. 

2. Firearm Improvements
After this update, when using a firearm, a small HUD will appear that makes it more intuitive to aim and shoot. Crosshairs have been added as well for keyboard/mouse players. Aside from that, each firearm has been improved and better defined, allowing players to better strategize their use of the firearms. 
- Wanderer
ㄴ Increase the rate of fire 
ㄴ Increase the bullet speed
- Badger
ㄴ Increased fired shots from 3 to 7
ㄴ Increased the damage when fired at close range
ㄴ Increased the overall range
- Red Panther
ㄴ Increased the splash range
ㄴ Increased the overall damage
- Thunder
ㄴ Increased the range
ㄴ Greatly increased the rate of fire

We hope that these changes will add more diversity in how you tackle obstacles and enemies.

3. Changes and Fixes
- Fixed an issue where certain elite monsters would not respawn after a player death
- Added an indicator for monsters that carry the Containment Cell Keys
- Fixed an issue where certain treasure chests were not correctly displayed in the 4th stage ([spoiler]The Capital[/spoiler])
- Fixed several issues related to a boss in Stage 4 ([spoiler]Devil Shinman in the Capital[/spoiler]), allowing for a more stable experience
- Fixed an issue where in the Ruined City, under certain circumstances, the Wanderer gun did not appear as intended.
- Fixed an issue where the portal to the final area did not appear as intended.
- Improved the final area of the game so that players have a method of replenishing consumables
ㄴ Jaran has been added to the final area of the game. You can purchase consumables through Jaran, so we hope that this will alleviate some stresses for players who aren't sure if they should use their items.
- Added the final artifact to Dongbaek's Shop for players to purchase: Balanced Object
- Fixed certain other minor bugs and made minor improvements to certain areas of the game

We sincerely hope that this patch will make the game a lot more fun for our players. Regardless of where issues are posted, whether it be in the Discord, Social Media, or on Steam, we will always try to listen and resolve issues as soon as possible. Thank you for supporting and showing love to The Devil Within: Satgat. As always, please do give us your feedback and hope to see you again with more good news. 

Thank you
~ Director of The Devil Within: Satgat

notes.title: The 1st Major Update // Build 0.5.72.40165
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

[previewyoutube=KXiAtu8TIIM;full][/previewyoutube]
Last week we mentioned some contents of the update. Today, we would like to take the time and provide more details regarding the update. The first major update includes many changes that we believe will meet the expectations of our community. With that being said, we unfortunately will have to start by mentioning some unfortunate news. 

Save File Progress
Because of the many changes that will happen with this update, your previous save file progress will not be able to carry over. We tried to work out ways where players can carry over their progress, but due to the huge changes to the underlying structure of the game, we unfortunately had to abandon the idea of save file compatibility. This was a decision that we did not make lightly and it was an inevitable choice for progress. We hope for your understanding. 

That being said, we understand that players will feel frustrated to have their entire progress reset. We also understand that those who want to make videos/stream the latest content would have to start over. Therefore, we have prepared a save file that will allow you to start from the beginning of the 3rd stage in Mirabeol. This way, you can enjoy the new contents of the game, be able to make your build as you want, search for all of the treasure chests, etc. While this isn't the most ideal solution, it is the best one that we can provide at the moment. 

Regarding this save file: 

Stage 1 and 2 cleared
No Silver/Gold Chests have been claimed (go back to Stage 1 + 2, take down Elite monsters for keys, and search for the chests!)
No Corruptor's Memory Shards have been cleared (read more in the patch notes)
No Haetae have been discovered (so you can search for them in the event of not getting the Steam Achievements in your previous file) 
No Engrams have been used (so you can make your own build and level up - you will start with a lot, so don't be alarmed by your level)
No weapons have been enhanced (so you can adjust your weapons in the event of not getting the Steam Achievement regarding enhancements)
Certain artifacts have been obtained due to necessity (via story progression up to the end of Stage 2)

* If you are new to the game, we highly recommend you to start from the beginning as using this save file will not clear certain Steam achievements automatically. 

To download the save file, please download the file from the following link:


The save file also comes with a readme file explaining how to install the save file. We again apologize for the inconvenience and we ask for your understanding. 

The First Major Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/f934a621765dfb255aebefd53f82762be36d4b53.jpg
This update brings massive improvements and exciting new content that the community has been asking for. While maintaining the core aspects of The Devil Within: Satgat, there has been a significant improvement to the overall gameplay experience, providing a smoother and more enjoyable time. The skills that you can learn through the skill tree have been restructured and re-purposed (and some new skills in there too!), so do check it out and see all the new changes! 

Difficulty Levels Added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/6f6e2fb08f7556ae3508d55cea0ba05fb51c797c.gif
You can now choose the difficulty level of the game: Easy, Normal, and Hard. Try out each difficulty to see which is more your speed. Different difficulties provide changes in enemy health and enemy patterns, the amount of Engrams that you can obtain from defeating enemies, as well as timing of the parry/dodge/charge mechanic. 

Stage Improvements
On the subject of stages, many areas have been altered and improved in order to build upon the exploration aspect of the game. Discover hidden secrets through the newly refined maps!

Weapon Distinctions - Choices Must be Made
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/67ca5c25b3f9fd2a74bfed174e71be1303bab084.gif
Weapons have become more distinct! If you are having a hard time on generating shock in an enemy, then use swords that increase the rate of shock! A core mechanic that has been expanded upon is the shock system - bosses will now be able to generate shock so you will have the opportunity to use Soul Destruction and gain health! 

Want to use your Concentrated Counterattacks at a faster pace? Then Cheonggang might be better suited for you! Try out different swords and see which matches your gameplay!

Accessories Added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/9e11d7d8051cfab0952126334cc2e43cb7b4e897.gif
To further augment your abilities, accessories have been added that can increase your offensive strength, reduce the damage taken, or even alter some of the item effects to your benefit. These accessories can be found all over stages in the game, some locked behind certain chests...

Powerful Elite Monsters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/9d599c79c599ef27aa94bf1cf3697d5313d265a0.gif
While previous versions of the game have had tougher monsters, this update will have special Elite monsters. Defeating them not only earns you an abundance of Engrams to fuel your growth, but also earns you Silver Keys to open chests with. 

Mysterious Treasure Chests
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/c04e7195e9ff26a6c90975ec12b9541027e02ad3.gif
Treasure chests have popped up in the world! Containing rare and powerful rewards, there are many for you to go find. These chests requires keys suited for them. As mentioned, you can find Silver Keys from defeating Elite monsters. However Gold Keys... 

Corruptor's Memory Shard - Boss Challenge
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/a5d9b473a22eb45da3d358f36522616fbfdc5fe9.gif
Once you defeat a stage boss, you can find the "Corruptor's Memory Shard" located in front of the entrance of the boss battle. This will allow you to challenge the boss at different difficulty levels (1 to 9), earning you unique rewards depending on the difficulty (like Gold Keys). Some levels will require you to turn up the game difficulty level, but you can adjust it back after you reap the rewards! Prove your victory was no fluke. 

Keep in mind that the Game Difficulty in the settings alters all levels of the bosses' health. Hard mode on level 1 has more health than easy mode level 1. Make sure to adjust the difficulty as needed! 

Campfire Warp
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/6798b9b0f1fb477690f4a58c0fef484885e3d166.gif
Forgot something in the stage? Still looking for those adorable Haetae? After you defeat the first stage boss, Lee Choong, you will be able to freely warp between Campfires of the Netherworld! This will allow you to move around quickly within a stage without having to trek too much!

Haetae Statue Warp
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/0a44fcf121a77844abb1cbd91b981e2a9c3fb293.gif
Speaking of those Haetae, what if you forgot a Haetae in a different stage? What if you finally got some more Gold Keys and you want to get that chest from way back when? After you defeat the second stage boss, Devil Lee Choong, Haetae Statues will appear in each stage (including Mirabeol) and you will be able to travel to stages that you previously visited! 

Refined Parrying System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/34defbd94290a61f5a584783ae787fb4ee8d017a.gif
The parrying system has been more refined. We resolved some issues where the timing didn't quite make sense or the animation didn't match the timing. 

AP System (Stamina) Penalty Adjustment
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/f0ddd3e0cd6bf1e1abcd30859995764f77b4d3ac.gif
You may have seen some teasers for this on Social Media, but the penalty for using up all of your AP has been reduced (meaning improved)! While before the update you were rendered immobile after being exhausted, this update will allow you to still move (albeit limited) and perform an emergency dodge!

We hope that this update further increases the quality and fun of the game. We are deeply grateful for your continued interest and support. As always, please let us know your feedback!

notes.title: Preview of the 1st Major Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for continuing to support 'The Devil Within: Satgat!' We have been hard at work on the next update, the first major one since Early Access began. In this notice, we would like to show some of the things that will be coming into the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/667bab2b38dca654b8fabdcde04fb80639202bb5.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/d88288be65bbba79d75eb0b7ef9339194f45fa98.jpg
The upcoming update is packed with many changes that we believe will meet the expectations of our community, adding layers of depth to the game. The overall flow and progression of the game has been improved to be smoother and much more enjoyable. Many things await our community, such as a variety of difficulties, boss challenges that really test your limits (depending on the difficulty that you select!), mysterious treasures hidden throughout the world that will enhance the exploration itch players have, and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/0a30575c1c1e23e2282f5d9de0bf51cb19ab2270.gif
In this upcoming update, the weapons and combat system have been significantly enhanced. The unique characteristics of each weapon have become more distinct and the parry system has been refined to maximize the thrill and excitement of combat. The AP System (stamina) penalty has also been eased, allowing for more mobility and evasion, greatly improving the flexibility of gameplay. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/5f6ef6bac58bb2fd777cecfd457988902ae838a1.gif
Speaking of mobility, a heavily requested feature is making its way to The Devil Within: Satgat -- fast travel. You can travel within the stage through campfires and between stages through Haetae statues (once it is unlocked), making your adventures more efficient and enjoyable. Improvements to various areas of the stages will allow players a more enjoyable exploration experience. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/cacd6ecc0123cf9ec5d2f482e53af83229e84410.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/ddad692d83baedac04476cf2bc0130dfd2ae04f6.jpg
We promise that this update will further enhance the overall quality and enjoyment of the game. We deeply appreciate your continued interest and support as we work towards providing the best action-platforming experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/68d3e717ec2005c54fe8dfb55c5a30165de6050c.png

Thank you. 
~ Director of The Devil Within: Satgat

notes.title: Update 2024.04.19 // Implementing Community Suggestions
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Since the launch of Early Access a little over a week ago, the game has improved drastically because of the feedback of the community over the past week. Today, a few more important changes based on community feedback regarding combat will be implemented! Please take a look at the changes below.

The following has been updated in the latest version of the game on April 19th GMT+9.

1. Adjustment to the AP System (Stamina)
There have been a wide variety of opinions regarding the difficulty of maintaining a steady offense due to the AP system. Players feel frustrated because they are required to take short moments of reprieve in order to regain stamina, despite the game being an action-platformer. We strongly agree with the feedback that current AP management system can be stifling and disrupt the flow of combat. 

Therefore, in today's patch, we are implementing a change where AP recovery is possible while using skills that do not consume AP. With this adjustment, players will be able to seamlessly continue their attacks by combining non-AP-consuming attacks (ie. light slash) after powerful AP-consuming attacks. We hope that players will feel more at ease in crafting long combos and strategies. 

AP can now be recovered in the following situations: 

Swordsmanship > Slash (Light Slash 1/2/3)
Swordsmanship > Jump + Light Slash
Swordsmanship > Aerial Slash (Lv. 1 and 2)
Agility > Penetration
Agility > Ambush
Special Skill > All levels of Concentrated Counterattacks
Soul Destruction

With these changes, we hope that players will have more freedom when it comes to stringing combos together. 
We will continue to monitor feedback regarding the AP system.

2. Skill Damage Balance
When it comes to the skills the Kim Rip is able to use, the ultimate goal was to balance the resources needed to use the skill with the output of the skill in question. 

To make each skill more distinct and powerful, the following changes will be applied:

Swordsmanship > Low Blow (Sword Qi) : Attack 300% → Attack 400%
Swordsmanship > Aerial Slash Lv. 1: Attack 50% → Attack 75%
Swordsmanship > Aerial Slash Lv. 3: Attack 50% → Attack 150%
Swordsmanship > Moon Strike: Attack 300% → Attack 400%
Swordsmanship > Flying Monkey: Attack 100% → Attack 170%
Toughness > Moonslash (Refined and Savage): Consumes AP 2 → Consumes AP 1
Agility > Penetration: Consumes AP 1 → Consumes AP 0 (Change from mid-level attack to light attack)

3. Added a Skip Tutorial Function
The game's tutorial was intended to get the player accustomed to not only the story, but also the basic game mechanics. However, we recognize that there are players who want to get on with the main gameplay. Therefore, we added a feature that will allow players to skip the tutorial and start the main game. 

During the tutorial, players can open the menu to skip the tutorial. Any information gained through the tutorial can be found in the System > Tips menu. 

[Other Changes and Fixes]

Added a feature that indicates the direction of objectives on the map when the objective is not currently able to be seen. 
Fixed an issue where pressing "Continue" on the main menu would load the 1st save file only. 
Improved tooltip visibility of locked/unattainable skills.
Increased the duration of Overflowing Golden Elixirs from 15 seconds to 30 seconds. 
Fixed other minor issues.

As always, we will continue to listen to feedback from our community and make improvements to the game so that players will have the best gameplay experience. 

We hope that you enjoy the contents of this patch and thank you for your support. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/68d3e717ec2005c54fe8dfb55c5a30165de6050c.png

Thank you. 
~ Director of The Devil Within: Satgat

notes.title: Update 2024.04.16 // Addressing More Feedback!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Today's update includes some changes that will help players overcome some of the difficulties of the game. We hope that players enjoy the game more with the changes listed below.

The following has been updated in the latest version of the game on April 16th GMT+9.

1. Special Weapon Added
After this patch, if the player dies 2 or more times, they will receive a special sword named Eggscalibird.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/a5ade6ca7b11389608e034a7779d4d55e1dde1e9.gif
Although it may look a bit silly, it is actually a very helpful sword in overcoming the early parts of the Early Access version of the game. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/81e74571f9773c0a6cb1c1295ef2137a24f795a6.gif
We will continue to add things that are both useful and fun for players whenever the opportunity presents itself.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/c033446161e74d6e0d982bd0c2527e6c47c887b6.png

2. Buffing the 'Soul Destruction' Skill
As we have been watching players, we noticed that the 'Soul Destruction' skill has been of little use. We sincerely apologize for not being able to notice sooner. 

After this patch, using the 'Soul Destruction' skill will recover 20% of the player's health and inflict AOE (area of effect) damage to surrounding enemies. We hope that the 'Soul Destruction' skill is a bit more helpful in tight situations where Purity Pellets are no longer an option. 

3. Adjusting the Wall Jump Mechanic
Many players have been requesting improvements to the wall jump mechanic and it took us some time to consider and apply changes. 

Starting from this patch, players will only need to apply a directional input on the first wall jump of a chain of wall jumps. Every subsequent wall jump will be activated regardless of directional input. 
We believe that this change will bring significant improvements to the mechanic. We will continue to listen to player feedback!

[Other Changes and Fixes]

 [Stage 2 - Dark Forest] Improved lighting in certain areas of the Dark Forest. 
 Fixed an issue where progression was not possible in the event of a double K.O. during the Lee Choong boss fight. 
 Fixed an issue where the hit box for Mother Gaia's head was too small for bullets. 
 Fixed an issue where in certain circumstances, the game would end when monsters summoned by Mother Gaia would attack. 
 Fixed other minor issues.

Another update will be scheduled for later this week! 
We hope that you enjoy the contents of this patch and thank you for your support. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/68d3e717ec2005c54fe8dfb55c5a30165de6050c.png

Thank you. 
~ Director of The Devil Within: Satgat

notes.title: Update 2024.04.12 // Addressing Feedback!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Today's update is quite an important one, as it includes a lot of things that we promised earlier this week. 
This not only includes some quality of life changes, but also resolving issues that dampened the gameplay experience. 

The following has been updated in the latest version of the game on April 12th GMT+9.

1. Improved the light slash mechanics: 

 Increased the speed of the light slash combos.
 Modified so that the player can change direction in the middle of a light slash combo.
 Modified so that players can jump/dash in the opposite direction during a light slash combo.
 Modified so that players can cancel out of doing the light slash combo skill, Triple Strike.

With these adjustments, not only should attacking with light slash be smoother, but also counter-attacking against enemies will feel far more fluid. 

2. Providing Ways to Overcome Difficult Situations When Retrying

 Reduced the cost of resetting the tech tree significantly.
 Added "Refine Weapon" to the Campfire. 
 Added random weapon enhancement material drops to monsters in Stage 2 and onwards. 

With these adjustments, we hope that players will have a more enjoyable experience in getting stronger to overcome difficult boss battles.

3. BGM (Background Music) Issues Resolved
In certain areas of the game, the BGM either did not play or did not loop as intended. This dampens the player experience significantly. However, thanks to player feedback, we were able to not only figure out the reason why certain BGM did not play as intended but were also able to solve it. With this update, we have confirmed that most, if not all, areas have been patched correctly and the BGM should be functioning as intended. 

With that being said, if there are any strange issues going forward, please do let us know as you have done so already. We truly are grateful to the community and appreciate your feedback. 

4. Resolved Issues Surrounding Mother Gaia
Since the launch of Early Access, we have not only been monitoring players through their streams and videos, but also gathering feedback through various channels. It was very clear that there were numerous issues regarding the Mother Gaia fight, the stage boss of the Abandoned Land. 

Despite our testing internally and ongoing investigations of the issues, we were not able to reproduce this issue. However, it was evident that many players were encountering this issue at an alarming rate. It honestly made us feel defeated in that we were not able to reproduce the issue.

In this update, however, we have completely revamped how it operates under the hood, conducted a series of tests, and expect that most of the problems encountered during the fight with Mother Gaia will have been resolved. 

[Other Changes and Fixes]

 Fixed an issue where certain parts of the UI were not working as intended.
 Added the option to turn on/off voice overs in Settings > Gameplay > Talk Voice.
 Because of the addition of the on/off toggle for voice overs, player settings may have been reset. Please adjust them before playing again.
 Fixed an issue where after certain gimmicks (ie. the conveyor belts in stage 2, the tumor bulbs in stage 1) are activated/cleared, the activation/clearing of the gimmick is not saved after death or restart. 
 Fixed an issue where in certain circumstances, players were not able to use the Concentrated Counterattack during the tutorial. 
 [Stage 2 - Dark Forest] Adjusted the attack of Metal Eye (flame-throwing machine enemy) so that it can now be guarded against as well as can be escaped from upon being hit. 
 Adjusted the position of the Engram cluster left by the player after they die to a boss to be outside the boss room upon retrying. 
 Fixed an issue where in certain circumstances, the player can fall infinitely through the map after using "Chasing Grasp."
 Increased the hit box of Aerial Slash.
 Fixed other minor issues (ie. text issues with the apostrophe/comma, incorrect button inputs in the skill tree, etc).


We at Newcore Games will continue to listen to and respond to the feedback of our players. We strive to provide the best gaming experience to the community. 

We look forward to your continued interest, support, and of course your feedback. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/68d3e717ec2005c54fe8dfb55c5a30165de6050c.png

Thank you. 
~ Director of The Devil Within: Satgat
